title: Data warehouse migration to Azure, proven on your own supply chain tables first
subtitle: Recordly proposal | Pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution, Espoo
footer: Recordly | Oriola Oyj | Data Warehouse Migration

slides.title: We migrate your DW to Azure in 9 months for €168,000, and prove velocity in 8 weeks first
bullets: **Phase 1 (8 weeks, €38,000 fixed):** migrate real supply chain tables (orders, stock, deliveries) end to end and publish measured velocity: tables per week, defects, reconciliation rate
**Then decide:** phases 2-3 go ahead only if the measured velocity holds; no multi-year lock-in
**One standard, no one-off scripts:** a metadata-driven ingestion framework for every SAP S/4HANA and wholesale interface, same pattern in every warehouse environment
**Reliable reporting:** reconciled Gold layer feeding your BI tool, with automated data tests
**Team:** 3 of 4 named consultants to be confirmed in writing at signature; replacement on request accepted

slides.title: One metadata-driven pipeline pattern replaces hand-crafted wholesale scripts
bullets: Adding a wholesale or warehouse interface = **one config row + tests**, not a new script. The same template runs in every warehouse environment.
Built only in Oriola's Azure tenant and Git; no new licences. Azure consumption estimated €2,500–4,000/month, sized in phase 1.

diagram.band: CI/CD from shared templates · alerts with runbooks so incidents get fixed once, not fire-fought every week

slides.note: Decision in phase 1: Data Factory vs Databricks ingestion per interface type, chosen on measured throughput, not preference.

slides.title: Three gated phases with measured velocity, not a big-bang programme
table: Framework v1, 15-20 supply chain tables migrated + reconciled, velocity report
Tables/week plus targets agreed after the first measurement (proposed: reconciliation ≥ 99.9%, ≥ 80% of interfaces config-only), no unrecovered load failure > 4 h: go/no-go
All wholesale + warehouse domains on the framework, BI repointed
Parallel run, legacy switch-off, runbooks, training
